about: Style family per artist for Calvin's 'Fall Bangers'. Claude's read from artist knowledge, labels and co-artists (2026-11-15), not measured and not stated by Calvin. Correct freely. Families that also exist in Krish's graph keep his slug, name and definition, so the two brains can be compared family by family; artists who appear in both playlists sit in the same family in both. Two families are new here (disco_indie_dance, afro_latin_club). The match is on the credited artist name, case-insensitive.

groove_tech_house.name: Groove-led tech house
groove_tech_house.description: The 2024-26 club turn at 124-130 BPM: rolling, swung basslines, crisp percussion, sparse stabs and chopped vocal hooks; driving and playful, with little harmony or melody.

uk_soulful_club.name: UK and soulful vocal house
uk_soulful_club.description: Garage swing, diva or soul vocals, organs and chunky basslines; disco and nu-disco edges.

disco_indie_dance.name: Disco, French touch and indie dance
disco_indie_dance.description: Filtered disco loops, funk guitar and talkbox, French-touch pumping, and indie-dance remixes and re-edits at 120-126 BPM: bright, warm, joyful, with a song or a sample at the centre. New in Calvin's brain; Krish's graph files Purple Disco Machine-style tracks under uk_soulful_club's disco edge.

afro_latin_club.name: Afro and Latin club house
afro_latin_club.description: Afro house built for the club rather than the sunrise: log drums and congas, chanted or Latin vocal hooks, a firm four-to-the-floor at 120-124 BPM. New in Calvin's brain; harder and more driving than Krish's organic_afro_house.

low_confidence.about: Artists Claude knows little about; family judged from title, label and co-artists only.
